items.html: And so it was also at the head of Atzilut, in the secret of 'all of them You made with wisdom.' For the light of Ein Sof became clothed in the supernal Hochma that is above Atzilut, and that same Hochma descended and broke the screen that is above Atzilut, and her very existence descended and was clothed in Atzilut, and through her Atzilut receives the light of Ein Sof. And this is the secret of 'all of them You made with wisdom,' mentioned in the world of Atzilut.
